questions.stem_text: Which of the following is NOT included in GDP?

options.A: Federal government purchases of goods and services.
options.C: State and local government purchases of goods and services.

questions.stem_text: Which of the following indicates that two goods are complements?

options.D: A demand elasticity greater than one

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - A negative cross-price elasticity

questions.stem_text: An effective price ceiling in the market for good X likely results in

options.A: a persistent surplus of good X.
options.B: a persistent shortage of good X.
options.C: an increase in the demand for good Y, a substitute for good X.
options.D: a decrease in the demand for good Z, a complement with good X.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - a persistent shortage of good X.

questions.stem_text: Which of the following policies best describes supply-side fiscal policy?

options.A: An increase in the money supply
options.C: Lower taxes on research and development of new technology

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Lower taxes on research and development of new technology
